game.title: Ink Immortal City
building.noLinhKhi: {name} lacks Qi — connect a spirit road to a Qi Gathering Array.
news.0: Rumor has it a new spirit spring surfaced east of town; rogue cultivators are flocking in.
news.1: The spirit fields had a bumper harvest; even the granary mice asked to retire.
news.2: The Qi Gathering Array runs stronger; mortals sleep so well the snoring fills the village.
hint.build: Drag the map to choose a spot, then tap Place
hint.roadStart: Tap a tile to start the road
hint.roadEnd: Tap the end tile (goes across, then down)
hint.demolish: Tap a building or road tile to remove
reason.blocked: Blocked by terrain or a building
sect.title: Sect
sect.autosave: The game autosaves after every change and when you leave the app.
hint.roadReady: Tap Build road, or tap another tile to change the end
zone.note: Paint zones for mortals. Tiles next to a spirit road grow houses by themselves while the Three Talents show demand; better Qi and feng shui let them grow taller.
hint.zoneStart: Tap one corner of the zone
hint.zoneReady: Tap Zone, or tap another tile to move the corner
demand.title: Three Talents
demand.income: Last solar term income: {n} Spirit Stones
demand.help: A tall bar means demand: zone more of that kind. A bar pointing down means surplus.
fs.label: Feng shui
quest.label: Heavenly Dao Decree
quest.allDone: All current decrees are complete. The Immortal Town opens in a later version.
quest.connect.title: Connect the lonely Disciple Quarters
quest.connect.desc: A Disciple Quarters in the southwest has no Qi (red 氣 bubble). Buildings only work when a spirit road links them to a Qi Gathering Array.
quest.connect.hint: Tap Show me: I'll hand you the Spirit Road tool and mark two tiles 一, 二. Tap 一, then 二, then Build road.
quest.zoneCu.title: Zone 6 tiles of Homes
quest.zoneCu.desc: Mortals build their own houses on zoned land next to a spirit road. Homes are the first step of a town.
quest.zoneCu.hint: Tap Show me: I'll hand you the Homes zone and mark two corners 一, 二. Tap 一, then 二, then Zone. A few houses appear right away.
quest.residents.title: Welcome 20 mortals
quest.residents.desc: Houses grow each solar term while the Homes bar of the Three Talents is high.
quest.residents.hint: Tap Ride the Wind to speed time up. Tap a lot to see why it isn't growing yet.
quest.thi.title: Open a Market (6 jobs)
quest.thi.desc: Mortals need somewhere to trade. A tall Market bar in the Three Talents means demand.
quest.thi.hint: Zoning → Market, a few tiles beside a spirit road. Markets pay the most tribute.
quest.dien.title: Till Spirit Fields (6 jobs)
quest.dien.desc: Spirit Fields feed the town and the sect. Without them the Fields bar shoots up.
quest.dien.hint: Zoning → Spirit Fields on tiles beside a spirit road; away from the market is fine.
quest.vein.title: Raise a second Qi Gathering Array on a vein
quest.vein.desc: An array on a spirit vein node is 2.5× stronger. One node is still untapped.
quest.vein.hint: Turn on the Heavenly Eye to see vein nodes (gold tiles) in the southwest. Build an array over one, then connect a spirit road.
quest.fengShui.title: Quarters with good feng shui
quest.fengShui.desc: Mountain behind, water in front, near a vein: one point each, +10% output per point.
quest.fengShui.hint: Hold a Disciple Quarters: big gold dots mark good feng shui. The northeast has both cliffs behind and the stream ahead.
quest.population.title: Reach 100 population
quest.population.desc: Keep the three bars of the Three Talents balanced so the town grows evenly.
quest.population.hint: Zone more of whichever bar is tallest. Strong Qi on the roads lets houses reach higher levels.
quest.wealth.title: Save 2000 Spirit Stones
quest.wealth.desc: Prepare to raise the Cave Abode into an Immortal Town.
quest.wealth.hint: Markets and buildings with good feng shui earn the most. Ride the Wind to fast-forward.
tut.0: Welcome, new Sect Master! This cave abode is where our sect begins. Let me show you around quickly.
tut.1: Drag one finger to move around the map, pinch to zoom. Tap a building to see whether it has enough Qi.
tut.2: Spirit Stones are your money. Population counts your people. Qi coverage is the share of buildings receiving Qi: below 100% means something is starved.
tut.3: Time flows in solar terms. Each term collects tribute and new houses grow. Ride the Wind to fast-forward, Meditate to pause.
tut.4: The Heavenly Eye reveals Qi flowing along spirit roads and the hidden spirit vein nodes underground.
tut.5: Three Talents: the Homes – Market – Fields bars. A tall bar means mortals need that kind of land. Tap for details.
tut.6: Build: spirit roads and sect buildings. Zoning: mark land where mortals build their own houses.
tut.7: Region Map: step outside the Cave Abode and send Dao Squads to mine Spirit Stones. Stones reach storage only when the squad gets home.
lot.noAccess: Not beside a spirit road: houses only grow on tiles next to a road. Run a spirit road here.
lot.declining: Declining: Qi on the nearby road has weakened or the road is gone.
lot.full: At its highest level. To grow taller, raise Qi on the nearby road (closer to a Qi Gathering Array) or pick a spot with good feng shui.
lot.noDemand: Nobody needs this kind of land yet (its Three Talents bar is low). Zone what is in demand first.
lot.surplus: Oversupplied: there is too much of this kind, so some houses stand empty.
lot.growing: Mortals want to move in: houses will grow or level up over the next solar terms.
toast.saveFail: Could not save to this device (browser storage full or blocked). Your current game is still here — use Sect → Export save to keep your progress.
squad.title: Dao Squad {g} · Guardian {name}
squad.hint: Tap a Spirit Stone mine to send the squad or change its target.
squad.back: Dao Squad {g} is home: +{n} Spirit Stones
home.card: Your sect's Cave Abode. Cargo goes into storage when a squad reaches the gate.
reason.noPath: No way there (mountains or water in the way)
reason.busy: Another Dao Squad is working this mine
reason.full: Cargo is full — recall the squad first
quest.expedition.title: First expedition
quest.expedition.desc: Beyond the Cave Abode lies the Region Map with Spirit Stone mines. Send a Dao Squad to gather; stones only reach storage when the squad gets home.
quest.expedition.hint: Tap the Region Map chip, tap a mine (石 seal), then Set out. You can change target or Recall on the way.
tut.8: This is your Heavenly Dao Decree: what to do next. Tap it to read the hint, and Show me points you to the exact spot.
